podcast.body: An EP released in 2001. The artwork for this EP, which depicted a panda with "panda eyes," was directly inspired by a memorable incident at Edgefest 1999 involving Universal Music's marketing representative, Iber Hamilton, who attempted a stage dive in a giant panda costume. "And the great thing about it is that in 2001, I released that EP, Loser Anthem."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Matt Good: In His Own Words - Part 1
